analysis: The trial completed successfully with host validation macro HR@10=0.5038: +0.0038 over the supplied current result of 0.5000, but −0.0349 below the historical best of 0.5387. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV=0.5300, Industrial_and_Scientific=0.5300, Electronics=0.3450, and CDs_and_Vinyl=0.6100. Electronics remained the weakest category. Masked pairwise logistic loss produced a modest improvement over the current result but did not surpass the reported balanced-BCE best; these results do not establish why. Allocated GPU time was 391.42 seconds.
code_summary: Trained one independent ConvRec per category and loaded exactly one selected checkpoint per category, without ensembling. The network uses tied 96-dimensional item embeddings, four residual causal convolution blocks with dilations 1/2/4/8, two-head causal attention, gated causal prefix-mean memory, final layer normalization, and jointly learned item biases. The controlled change was the ranking objective: softplus(negative_score − positive_score), using 256 shared uniform negative draws, masking target collisions, and averaging over allowed negatives and supervised positions, capped at 2,048 positions. Sequence preparation, seed 42, AdamW, learning-rate schedule, validation checkpoint selection, four-category routing, and strict predictor reconstruction were retained.
